doc: The SMC-Mixer configuration schema (SPEC D-4, docs/config.md): the one description of the configuration. tools/smcconf/gen.py generates from it the C structures (firmware/core/core_config.h), the device codec's tables (firmware/config/cfg_schema.h), the JSON Schema of configuration files (config/smc-config.schema.json) and the field reference in docs/config.md; tools/smcconf reads it to convert files. Field order is the binary order.

device.doc: This firmware's counts (SPEC FR-MOD-02): the file and binary formats do not depend on them; a configuration for more presets or pages is refused by a device with fewer.

values.doc: CC 14-bit: MSB on number (0-31), LSB on number + 32
value = velocity; 0 releases the note, in the preset's form (noteOff)
NRPN, 14-bit: parameter number = MSB x 128 + LSB (CC 99/98), value on CC 6 and 38
RPN, 14-bit: parameter number = MSB x 128 + LSB (CC 101/100), value on CC 6 and 38
sends once it meets the target's value
the output converges on the fader

enums.name: encMode
enums.doc: encoder mode (FR-CTL-04); div and step take n

values.doc: no acceleration: the fine step per click (1 for 7-bit targets, the range / 2048 for 14-bit ones, global.fine14)
fine adjustment, the default Shift layer: the fine step, without acceleration
press sends hi, release sends lo
each press switches between hi and lo
active while the button is down
a short press latches, a hold is temporary

enums.name: noteOff
enums.doc: how a note is released (FR-CTL-10), per preset

values.doc: Note On with velocity 0, as the stock firmware

enums.name: paramNull
enums.doc: the null parameter after an NRPN or RPN gesture (FR-CTL-01, SPEC Q-21 c), per preset

values.doc: RPN 127/127 (CC 101, 100) when a gesture that sent NRPN or RPN ends

enums.name: layerMode
enums.doc: when Shift changes a moving control's layer (FR-SH-05)

values.doc: at the start of a gesture

enums.name: fine14
enums.doc: the fine step of an encoder on a 14-bit target (FR-CTL-04)

values.doc: 1: the finest step a 14-bit target has

enums.name: save
enums.doc: how the mixer saves its configuration to flash (SPEC Q-26, FR-APP-11)

values.doc: by itself, 3 s after the last change and touch

assignment.doc: One layer of a control: what it sends. Fields that do not apply to the type, kind or mode must be absent (zero on the device); a required one must be given where it applies.

fields.doc: message type

named.doc: the preset's channel: changes with it

fields.doc: MIDI channel: 1-16, fixed, or preset
CC, note or parameter number (cc14: 0-31; nrpn, rpn: 0-16383, MSB x 128 + LSB)
by kind: fader pickup, encoder mode, button mode
encoders, div and step: N
button flags

members.doc: the button's LED: value (lit while the value is not lo), off, on

valueDoc.value: lit while the value is not lo

fields.doc: the value at rest / off; lo > hi inverts
the value at the top / on
encoders: the value of a target that has none yet (no MIDI from the instrument yet)

control.doc: A control: its Normal layer, its Shift layer and how the Shift layer is made (FR-MOD-03, FR-SH-02).

fields.doc: CORE_SHIFT_OVERRIDE

shift.doc: In a file: "inherit" (the Normal layer), "block" (nothing), or a layer of its own, written in full as the Normal layer is (its type at least). Absent: the kind's default; for an encoder with a type, fine: the Normal layer in mode fine.

strip.doc: A strip of a page: a fader, an encoder and the buttons M, S, R and SELECT.

row.doc: The bottom row (global controls, FR-MOD-01): the same on every page. The Shift layer of the eight navigation buttons is the firmware's (FR-SH-02).

preset.doc: A preset: its pages of strips, the bottom row, and its own settings.

fields.doc: MIDI channel of the assignments whose channel is preset
Shift mode
note release form
the null parameter after an NRPN or RPN gesture
FR-SH-05
the default fader pickup
a pause this long ends a gesture
hybrid Shift: a shorter press latches
encoder acceleration: the speed scale in percent (more accelerates sooner)
the fine step of encoders on 14-bit targets
how the mixer saves its configuration (Q-26); the core does not read it
the brightness of lit LEDs: 1 dimmest, 10 full; even steps to the eye (§5.7)
the glow of unlit LEDs: 0 dark, 1–10 as ledLevel (§5.7)

file.doc: A configuration file (SPEC FR-APP-21): JSON, UTF-8. Names live only here (D-8).

binary.doc: The device's form (docs/config.md, "Binary form"): a header, then records.

records.name: global
records.doc: mask u8, then the global fields that differ from their defaults

records.name: preset
records.doc: preset u8, mask u8, then the preset fields that differ from their defaults

records.name: assign
records.doc: page u8 (255: the bottom row), control u8, mask u16, then the Normal layer's fields that differ from their defaults (a required one always)

records.name: shift
records.doc: page u8, control u8, kind u8; override: mask u16, then the fields that differ from the Normal layer

records.name: global2
records.doc: optional (an older firmware skips it): mask u8, then the global fields of this record ("record": "global2") that differ from their defaults
